English Proficiency Requirements
English Proficiency Requirements
International applicants must meet the English proficiency standards set by the University of Colorado Boulder, the Graduate School and specific Graduate Departments to which they are applying. Proof of English proficiency is required for an international application to be reviewed for an admission decision.
Proof of English proficiency is NOT required if:
You are a citizen of a qualifying country
You have studied at a university-level institution that meets ALL the following criteria:
The institution is in the U.S. or a qualifying country
You have completed at least one year of full-time academic study at the institution.
Your studies at the institution ended within two years of your intended admission term.
Examples:
Admission Term: Fall 2026 → Studies ending Spring 2024 =
Admission Term: Fall 2026 → Studies ending Fall 2023 =
You provide Official transcripts verifying all criteria.
You have completed OPT (Optional Practical Training) that meets ALL the following criteria:
Your Employment ended within two years of your intended admission term.
Examples:
Admission Term: Fall 2026 → Completed OPT August 2024 =
Admission Term: Fall 2026 → Completed OPT December 2023 =
You provide a report of your OPT employment history from your SEVP portal AND a copy of your Form I-20 that includes your OPT extension information. This can be uploaded as part of your transcript or emailed intlgrad@colorado.edu.
IMPORTANT
MusicDOES NOT ACCEPT condition #2 or #3 above and require English proficiency test scores for international applicants. (Please review the College of Music English proficiency waiver policy and application).
Enrollment in an English language program (even if the program is in the U.S.) DOES NOT meet the English proficiency requirement.
Medium of Instruction (MOI) letters are NOT accepted and DO NOT meet the English proficiency requirement.
Applicants who do not meet the criteria for requirements 1, 2 or 3 can fulfill the English proficiency requirements through the exams posted below.
English proficiency can be demonstrated by completing any of the exams below and obtaining a score that is equal to, or higher than, Your Department’s posted score on the Minimum Score table below.
Note that all scores must be Official and the exam date must be within 2 years of your intended admission term.
Examples:
Admission Term: August 2026 → Exam Date September 2024 =
Admission Term: August 2026 → Exam Date April 2023 =

How to provide proof of English proficiency
Applicants may upload a Verifiable EP Score Report with their application materials when applying. Alternatively, applicants may email Verifiable EP Score Reports to intlgrad@colorado.edu. The University of Colorado Boulder accepts the following exams and corresponding Verifiable EP Score Reports listed below.
TOEFL: Must show Applicant Name, Appointment Number, Date of Birth and MyBest Scores Date.
TOEFL IBT26: Must show Applicant Name, Appointment Number, Date of Birth and MyBest Scores Date.
IELTS: Must show Applicant Name, Test Report Form Number (TRF), Date of Birth and Test Date.
Duolingo: Must show Applicant Name, Secure Certificate Link and Test Date, must be Shared.
PTE (Pearson): Must show Applicant Name, Score Report Code, Date of Birth and Test Date.
Cambridge: Verification Number is required, Date of Birth must match applicant, and Candidate Name must match applicant.
If we are not able to verify your English Proficiency Test Scores, you may be required to send Official Test Scores directly from your testing agency listed below.
TOEFL: Valid for 2 years. Send via your ETS account to University of Colorado Boulder. Our school code is 4841 (use department code 99 if needed).
IELTS: Valid for 2 years. Request your test center to send scores to:
University of Colorado Boulder Masters & PhD
3100 Marine Street, Suite A122, UCB 65, Boulder, CO 80303
Duolingo: Valid for 2 years. Use the Duolingo dashboard to send results to:
University of Colorado Boulder – Graduate
PTE (Pearson): Valid for 2 years. Send your scores from your online myPTEportal to the University of Colorado Boulder, Department = Graduate School.
Leeds MBA/MS applicants must send scores to the University of Colorado Boulder, Department = Leeds MBA/MS.
Cambridge: Valid for 2 years. Instructions for how to send your exam result is available on the Cambridge website.
